evaluation.bits_per_char: total nats over evaluated targets divided by the exact character span of those targets (prefix decodes)
evaluation.chunking: non-overlapping chunks of up to block_size tokens within a section; the first token of a chunk has no left context; the last token of a section is not predicted
evaluation.metric: main next-token cross-entropy only (no MTP, no aux)

generation.note: sampling uses a private CPU generator per run; no EOS handling, so every run fills the token budget
prompts: To be, or not to be

router.probability: softmax over all experts before top-k
